title: INQUIRE URIMAP START / NEXT / END: a browse of the installed definitions, ILLOGIC for a START inside a browse, END past the last, a console message

scenarios.summary: GT61 browses the four installed URIMAPs, starts GT62 for the one whose name and path both qualify, and logs
GT61 twice: the END of the first browse closes it, so the second run's first START is NORMAL again, not ILLOGIC
